title: Garmin unveils Tacx Nēra, an immersive indoor smart trainer with integrated movement
summary: Garmin today announced Tacx® Nēra, a powerful and connected indoor smart trainer purpose built for cyclists with realistic motion along with power and cadence accuracy within 1%.
